scope: 15 independent long/cash accounts; no portfolio or options
reserve_policy: Downloaded and quality audited only; no feature selection, fitting, forecasts or scoring on reserved dates. Historical reserve is not guaranteed unseen by prior team research. Prospective validation requires a later frozen deployment recipe.
macro_gate: Quarantined until release/vintage availability is verified. Lagged current FRED daily observations are archived diagnostic features only.
inner_objective: mean annual net return / annual return standard deviation (daily Sharpe at zero cash rate), pooled prior inner years; tie break recipe ID then fixed sizing
learner_policy: CART primary throughout; RF and XGBoost separately reported fixed-family challengers on the CART-selected recipe, with no promotion from outer results
sizing_selection: fixed or capped volatility targeting selected on earlier inner results
distribution_accounting: Consistently Yahoo dividend/split-adjusted OHLC total-return approximation; no separate dividend credits; fractional synthetic units; vendor actions need independent confirmation before official validation
weekly_clock: Last completed session of W-FRI week after close, next actual session open. Incomplete final week excluded.
label_clock: Entry next session open; outcome at open h sessions after entry; label available at outcome open. Strictly prior mature labels only at calendar year refit cutoff.
refit: annual expanding, uniform weights; recipe/sizing reselection once annually using only earlier inner windows
selection_purge: Training label end strictly before inner validation first decision and outer year start; 20-session common maturity gate across all recipes
news: Pinned FinBERT smoke test and news ingestion contract; historical trading features gated on qualified timestamped relevant versioned corpus
uncertainty: Moving block bootstrap of daily strategy-minus-buyhold returns, block length 20, 500 replicates; descriptive historical uncertainty after selection, not proof of significance
engineering_correction: v1 incomplete engineering run archived before final delivery; v2 retains December weekly decisions that execute at January open across year boundaries. No performance-driven parameter changes.
